title: Per-feature unit econ and hiring playbook Q2 2026
body:
Executive summary:
This working sheet lays out per-feature unit economics tied to a prioritized hiring cadence for Q3–Q4 2026, plus a compact pricing sensitivity framework and a short Monte Carlo run to highlight tail risks. Goal: produce concrete hiring triggers and pricing guardrails that preserve >=20% gross margin on hosted API while enabling growth in Dedicated and Private segments.

High-level takeaways (provisional):
- With current assumptions, base-case median gross margin across product mix = ~22%.
- A 12% reduction in average per-token price (across tiers) erodes median margin to ~8% unless we defer two mid-senior infra hires and reduce burst GPU spend by 15%.
- Upside from cross-sell of embedding-search feature to mid-market customers materially improves ARPU: +$4k ARR per converted customer (assumes 30% attach within 12 months).

Assumptions (inputs used in tables below):
- Time horizon: 12 months forward (Jul 2026–Jun 2027).
- Currency: USD.
- Discounting: none (operational budgeting sheet).
- Average hosted token throughput per MAU: 1.5M tokens/month for chat-heavy apps, 0.35M tokens/month for embeddings-only apps.
- Cost per token (infrastructure, GPU amortized, networking): Base = $0.00012/token (weighted mix of reserved + burst).
- Pricing tiers: Developer (low), Startup (mid), Enterprise (high) — blended ASP in base = $0.00024/token.
- Sales & solution engineering CAC payback: assumed 11 months for enterprise cohort in base case.

Feature-level unit economics (per-customer annualized):
- Chat product (mid-market customer):
  - Monthly token usage: 10M tokens -> annual = 120M tokens
  - Revenue: 120M * $0.00024 = $28,800 ARR
  - Incremental cost: 120M * $0.00012 = $14,400
  - Gross contribution margin per customer = $14,400 (50%)
- Embedding-search (SMB buyer):
  - Monthly token usage (embed calls) equivalent: 0.5M -> annual = 6M tokens
  - Revenue (feature price per call converted to token-equivalent): $6,000 ARR
  - Incremental cost: $720
  - Gross contribution margin per customer = $5,280 (88%)
- Summarization microservice (edge):
  - Annual tokens = 30M; revenue = $7,200; cost = $3,600; margin = 50%

Headcount plan (recommended hires and timing):
- Jul–Sep 2026: hire 2 infra engineers (inference runtime), 1 SRE (observability), 1 payroll financial analyst (revenue ops).
- Oct–Dec 2026: hire 1 senior solutions engineer (enterprise), 1 AE (enterprise), 1 ML infra research engineer (quantization/throughput).
- Jan–Mar 2027 (contingent): hire 1 product economist (pricing), 1 growth PM (self-serve flows) — contingent on hitting top-line triggers.

Average fully-burdened cost (annual) used in model:
- Infra engineer (mid): $220,000
- SRE (mid): $210,000
- Senior solutions eng: $260,000
- AE (quota-bearing): $190,000 base + 60% OTE (modeled as $310k fully-burdened)
- Product economist: $200,000
- ML infra research: $235,000
- Finance analyst: $120,000

Capacity & ops knobs (to control marginal cost):
- Reserved GPU utilization target: 72% (current). Increasing to 80% reduces cost/token by ~9% but may require short-term burst fees.
- KV cache prefix reuse: target +8% hit rate yields ~5% cost reduction for chat workloads.
- Quantization profile rollout (Q4): expected cost/token delta -18% for long-context models; requires 1x ML infra hire to execute.

Pricing sensitivity matrix (illustrative):
- Variable: Blended ASP change +/- 15%; Cost per token change +/- 20% (from GPU price variance or utilization).
- Key metric: Blended gross margin across product mix.
  - Case A (ASP -10%, cost base): margin falls from 22% -> 12%
  - Case B (ASP +5%, cost -10%): margin rises to ~30%
  - Case C (cost +20%, ASP unchanged): margin falls to -2% (loss-making)

Break-even and hiring triggers (rules of thumb):
- If blended ASP ≤ $0.00021/token for >30 days, pause non-critical hires (product economist, growth PM) and re-run scenario within 14 days.
- If burst GPU utilization >30% of total spend for >2 weeks while reserved utilization <70%, open investigation and consider short-term price adjustment on high-throughput enterprise tiers.
- If ARR from embedding attach to mid-market > $750k ARR by Dec 2026, accelerate 1 AE hire (pull forward Q4 AE).

Mini Monte Carlo (5000 draws) — high level summary (inputs):
- Random variables: monthly MAU growth (base 5% ± 6% sd), ASP (normal, mean = base, sd = 6%), cost/token (mean = base, sd = 8%).
- Outputs: blended gross margin distribution across horizon.
- Selected percentiles:
  - 10th percentile margin = -3% (draws dominated by cost spike + lower ASP + higher churn)
  - 50th percentile margin = 22%
  - 90th percentile margin = 36%
Note: downside concentrated in combinations of cost shock and poor attach rates for high-margin features (embeddings).

Sensitivity buckets (quick reference for leadership):
- Level Green (safe): margin >= 20% — actions: proceed with planned hires.
- Level Yellow (caution): margin 10–20% — actions: delay non-critical hires, tighten burst budgets, accelerate caching/quant rollout.
- Level Red (danger): margin < 10% — actions: pause hiring, implement selective price increases on developer tier, prioritize margin playbooks.

Open questions / unknowns to resolve (data needed):
- Real elasticity by region for enterprise vs startup — current proxy from Q1 experiments is noisy; need segmented A/B with region filter. (JIRA: JIRA-FIN-2218)
- Precise embedding attach conversion timeline by customer size — ask CS for cohort-level conversion calendar.
- GPU pricing outlook from cloud providers for 2027 — procurement to secure indicative quotes.

Action items (next 30 days):
- Finance + Prod econ: finalize Monte Carlo inputs and run 20k-draw sensitivity before next exec review (owner: Claire).
- Sales Ops: produce embed-attach cohort report (owner: Priya).
- Infra: validate runnable quantization roadmap and resource estimate (owner: Evan).
- Exec: review triggers at monthly ops cadence and confirm hiring gatekeeper list.

Notes to reviewer:
- This is a working sheet aimed to combine a feature-first unit-economics view with actionable hiring triggers. Numbers are high-level and meant for discussion; please annotate assumptions inline or add linked spreadsheets for granular model inputs.

Raw quick tables (paste-friendly):
Feature | Annual tokens | Revenue | Cost | Margin
Chat-mid | 120,000,000 | $28,800 | $14,400 | 50%
Embeddings-smb | 6,000,000 | $6,000 | $720 | 88%
Summarization | 30,000,000 | $7,200 | $3,600 | 50%

-- end of sheet --
